commit_note: Corrected by hand from 0335c84. This run used the runner as of e80b3df, which read HEAD at the end of the run; three builder commits landed meanwhile. The run started at 19:19:51, one second after e80b3df, and `git diff e80b3df 0335c84` is empty for every file /api/ask uses, so the answers come from e80b3df.
gemini_requests_note: Exact count not recoverable: this run predates the per-request counter (f3a9a76), and llm.py retried transient errors silently. The SDK itself does not retry (no retry_options: 'never retry'), so each llm.py attempt was one HTTP request. Exact: q02 = 4 (first try + 3 retries, all 503), q10-q16 = 1 each (daily-quota 429 is not retried). q01 and q03-q09 succeeded after 1 to 4 attempts each (a 503 followed by success is not logged). Total 19 to 43 requests; at least 12 before the quota ran out at q10. An earlier note said 'at most 12', which ignored retries that ended in success.
